name: AuthLayout
description: The sign-in page as a component (R-2F9). It has the same name and the same zones as `AuthLayout` in `packages/ui`. - **The brand panel:** a `BrandZone` on 46% of the width (40% under 1024px). It holds the logo, "Afacerea ta. Într-un singur loc." in `display-xl`, the chevrons and "© 2026 Ventora Systems". - **The sheet with the form:** the language selector at the top right, the form centred (400px, 480px with `wide`) and the footer. - **On phones** (the layout narrower than 768px): the panel becomes a band with the logo and the language selector, and the sheet rises over it with rounded corners. The statement, the chevrons and the © are hidden.
notes: Layout component: no events of its own.
